slides.h: Where money shows. Where it vanishes.
slides.dek: Five calls for furnishing a room, ranked by how visible the spend is.

body: The first thing eyes land on, and the only thing every guest looks up at.
A good fixture carries a plain room. A plastic one gives the game away from the doorway.
At arm's length nobody can tell the price of a cushion cover.
Buy inexpensive ones in the right colours and swap them each season instead.
Hang them at the ceiling, let them touch the floor. Heavy fabric moves like money.
Short curtains on a tall window are the most common giveaway in the country.
Trays, vases, bookends, the sculptural bowl. Thrift them, inherit them, find them.
An old object with some wear looks better on a shelf than anything from this month's catalogue.
The biggest mirror the wall can take. It doubles the light and the apparent size of the room.
One large piece beats five small ones every time.
Fixtures, mirrors, fabric with weight. Light finds them all day and shows their quality.
Save on what hands touch and eyes skim. That is where budgets disappear.
